gloss: to fan; to incite, to stir up

definitions.explanation: To move air with a fan or similar object to create a breeze.

examples.english: I fan my face with a paper fan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}いで⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧。
examples.english: I fan the fire to make it burn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}る⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧。
examples.english: News coverage that stirs up anxiety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、{浴衣|ゆかた}{姿|すがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うちわ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{涼|すず}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{扇|あお}いで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: On the night of the summer festival, a woman in a yukata was fanning herself to cool down.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}る⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}み→書き込み：09225_kakikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Posts that stir up conflict on social media are increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧、⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He incited the crowd's anger and escalated it into a demonstration.

notes:
{扇|あお}ぐ means to fan or create air movement.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}ぐ

COMMON PATTERNS:
- うちわ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{扇|あお}ぐ: to fan with a paper fan
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}ぐ: to fan a fire
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{扇|あお}る: to stir up anxiety

USAGE:
{扇|あお}る can mean to incite or inflame (emotions, conflict). In this sense, it's often written as ⟦{煽|あお}る→煽る：07924_aoru⟧.

NOTE: Don't confuse with ⟦{仰|あお}ぐ→仰ぐ：11454_aogu⟧ (to look up at, to respect).
